:::{#exm-matrix-equality}
#### Equal and unequal matrices

$$
\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix} \ne \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 5 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix} \ne \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

The second pair differs in one entry.
The third pair lists the same four numbers in the same order,
but one [matrix](#def-matrix) is $1 \times 4$ and the other $2 \times 2$,
so the two are not [equal](#def-matrix-equality).
